Anticipy
What should Anticipy do?
e.g. Open Gmail and tell me the subject of the most recent
email
Run
Runs against your real signed-in Chrome in an isolated Anticipy
window. It stops at password and payment walls.
notes: The image does not display the 'Now', 'Next', and 'Past' column headers. It shows a prompt for user input and a description of the app's functionality.
